head: hex, 5/16 AF, flat SEMS washer (.44-.50)
notes: AMK B-12173 (#10 x 1/2 hex AB, flat SEMS, phos) and camaros.net (10-16 x 1/2 5/16AF phosphate/oil tapping w/ .44 flat washer) agree, but camaros cites AMK so not fully independent. Paragon '450539 / 9427325 ... 8-32x3/8' pairs two GM numbers; the 8-32 machine thread likely belongs to 450539 - left as a disagreement, not used.
